title: Detection of Dimethyl Ether in the Central Region of the MWC 480 Protoplanetary Disk
question: Are sublimated complex organic molecules (CH3OCH3, CH3OCHO, CH3OH) present in the inner warm region of the full (non-transitional) MWC 480 Herbig Ae disk, and what are their excitation conditions and abundance ratios?

data.sensitivity: RMS 0.33 mJy/beam (00535) and 0.67 mJy/beam (00982) at 4 km/s channels

what.value: Disk density/temperature structure model tailored to MWC 480

evidence.quote: we used the disk model tailored to MWC 480 in (cite: Zhang2021)

what.value: Spectroscopic data and partition functions from CDMS and JPL

evidence.quote: are taken from the Cologne Database for Molecular Spectroscopy (cite: CDMS1; CDMS2; CDMS3) for CH$_3$OCH$_3$ and CH$_3$OH

external_data.citation: CDMS (cite: CDMS1; CDMS2; CDMS3); JPL (cite: JPL)

what.value: Systemic velocity ≈5.1 km/s and stellar mass 2.1 Msun
Abundance ratios of other disks (HD 100546, IRS 48) for comparison

evidence.quote: compares the abundance ratios of CH$_3$OCH$_3$ and CH$_3$OCHO relative to CH$_3$OH among HD 100546 (cite: Booth2024_HD100546), Oph IRS 48 (cite: Booth2024_IRS48), and MWC 480

what.value: Binding energies of CH3OCH3 and CH3OH

evidence.quote: binding energies of CH$_3$OCH$_3$(${\approx}4000$ K; (cite: Lattelais2011)) and CH$_3$OH(${\approx}5000$–5500 K; (cite: Ferrero2020; Minissale2022))

recipe.method: Pipeline calibration, align continuum peaks, phase and amplitude self-cal, uvcontsub, tclean cube at 4 km/s
Spatially integrate cube in 0.6 arcsec diameter circular aperture at disk center; moment maps with bettermoments without flux threshold
Cross-correlate visibilities with Keplerian kernel (i=37 deg, PA=148 deg, M=2.1 Msun, outer radius 0.15 arcsec)

recipe.goal: Fit LTE slab model for Tex, line width, column densities
recipe.method: Simultaneous 7-parameter LTE fit of four species with common Tex to all >600 transitions
assumptions: Common Tex for all species, optically thin, Gaussian line shape, Tcmb=2.73 K

recipe.goal: Radiative transfer test of spatial distribution
recipe.method: RADMC-3D image cubes from Zhang2021 disk structure with COMs set above sublimation temperatures (80/100 K for CH3OCH3; 100/120/140 K for CH3OH), z/r<0.3, Keplerian rotation; abundances adjusted to fit
assumptions: Gas temperature = dust temperature; constant abundance in regions above sublimation temperature

evidence.quote: we derived a CH$_3$OCH$_3$/CH$_3$OH column density ratio (lower limit) of ${>}7$

answer_key.quantity: Peak S/N of 299.89 GHz CH3OCH3 feature
Matched filter response of 299.89 GHz cluster
Disk-model abundance ratio x(CH3OCH3)/x(CH3OH) lower limits

evidence.quote: The constrained lower limits of the abundance ratios span ${\sim}0.3$–2

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channel ranges used for continuum and uvcontsub
Self-calibration solution intervals and reference antenna/spw choices
Image size, cell size, cleaning threshold and masks
Aperture-extraction details for spectrum conversion to beam-averaged units (primary beam correction)
Exact MCMC convergence diagnostics and initialization
Matched filter inclination-based kernel details beyond listed parameters
missing_for_reproduction: Full MWC 480 disk model from Zhang2021
score_reason: Clear spectral fit recipe with priors, line list and code; some imaging and selfcal details missing, and data proprietary period likely ended.
rediscovery_reason: Data from two ALMA Cycle 8 projects, a complete LTE fit recipe with priors and line list, and numeric results (Tex, N, ratio) are given.
